Work with me↗

The thread through the work.

An investment that needs testing. A policy that needs evidence. A programme that needs a credible cost and financing plan.

Across development economics, policy research and technical assistance, my work connects these questions to practical choices. The subject changes; the discipline stays consistent: understand the context, structure the evidence, test the alternatives and design for delivery.

My professional record spans 2006–2026 and includes consulting, specialist and leadership roles across economic and financial appraisal, feasibility studies, financing strategy, impact evaluation, public institutions and green transition.

Selected assignments include work for and with ADB, the World Bank, IFC, the European Commission, the Centre for Policy Dialogue and public institutions in Bangladesh. Roles and contracting relationships are described within each assignment.
